The PBAT Door-to-Door Movement, a group mobilising support of the re-election bid of President Bola Tinubu in 2027 is set to unveil a book on the stewardship of the president as preparation for the general election intensifies across various political parties.
Titled, “The Courage of Forum: Architecture of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, Beyond 2027: Statecraft and Vision for National Renewal,” the book unveiling is slated for Thursday, November 5, 2026, at the Bola Ahmed International Conference Centre, Abuja.
Addressing journalists at a news conference in Abuja on Wednesday, the Secretary, Central Planning Committee for the book presentation and launch, Mr Jethro Annum, described the work as a compendium of giant strides recorded in the past three and a half years of the President Tinubu-led government.
“The book documents and examines the major policy decisions and structural reforms undertaken by President Tinubu’s administration, highlighting their objectives, challenges and implications for Nigeria’s long-term development.
“It focuses on key initiatives, including fuel subsidy removal, comprehensive tax reforms, the establishment of the Nigerian Education Loan Fund, financial autonomy for local governments, the creation of Forest Guards, the proposal for state police and market liberalisation measures,” he said.
The reforms, Annum added, “reflect the administration’s stated commitment to restructuring public finance, expanding access to education, strengthening grassroots governance, addressing insecurity and creating a more competitive economic environment.
